Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka pulled things back later in the day with the wickets of Ryan Rickelton and Marco Jansen. They started Day 2 well with another wicket. It felt like they'll clean the tail quickly but Verreynne had other ideas. He played well with Rabada to bring up his century and have put his team in a very comfortable position here. Sri Lanka have a tricky period to play before Lunch, can they go unhurt?

This is a kind of body blow to Sri Lanka who have allowed the tail wag along with Verreynne who have scored a magnificent century to put his team on the front foot. Sri Lanka ended Day 1 on 269 but have allowed South Africa to score another 100 odd runs here which could make a big difference. It was all about Ryan Rickelton's century for South Africa. His partnership along with Bavuma was vital.

Sri Lanka were poor in the field and their bowlers lacked intensity as the day went on. Asitha Fernando was brilliant along with Kumara. The former was very unlucky. He has two to his name but could have had more. Sri Lanka have used the second new ball effectively. Can they clean up the tail quickly on Day 2? We will find out. Join us at 8 am GMT and an hour earlier for the build up. Cheers!

Temba Bavuma and David Bedingham fell in quick succession but Ryan Rickelton continued. Kyle Verreynne has given him able support and the two put in another good stand. The hosts were aiming for over 400 but with just Kyle Verreynne, the known batter out there now, it looks certainly out of their reach.

The wicket in the last two overs means the game has started on a decent note. Both teams will be happy with how things have panned out. A fine, fine ton from Ryan Rickelton has put South Africa slightly in the driver's seat. Let me remind you, after electing to bat, they lost a few wickets early but Rickelton and Bavuma then steadied the ship with a very good stand.

TEA! So, despite the wicket of Temba Bavuma, this session still belongs to the hosts. Temba Bavuma and Ryan Rickelton continued the good work and added quite a few valuable runs to the board. The two together added 133 runs with both notching up their respective fifties. The Lankan spinners were not able to produce any success and Dhananjaya de Silva turned back to his seamers for a breakthrough. The pacers used the same trick as they did in the first Test match. They used bouncers against Temba Bavuma and it worked in their favour. South Africa have lost their captain but there is still plenty of batting left. Let's see how things unfold in the final session.

TOSS - South Africa have won the TOSS AND ELECTED TO BAT!

Tha Lankan batters will be yet again Tested by the South African bowlers and we believe that's where the game will be decided. It is going to be very important for the seniors batters to step up and do a lot better. South Africa on the other hand, will love a repeat of the performance from the first game. Toss and teams in a bit.

The South Africans absolutely steam rolled the Lankans in the first game thanks to a brilliant performance from Marco Jansen. It is time for the second Test and it is a must win for Lanka if they are to avoid a series defeat. South Africa on the other hand, will look to win it and seal it and that will also help their chances of playing the WTC final.
